'''''Badger''''' was the designation given to a pair of [[cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] used by former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|fleet]] following Harkov's defection to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. Both vessels, designated ''Badger 1'' and ''Badger 2'', were present at the Rebel outpost [[DS 5]] in the [[Parmel system/Legends|Parmel system]] during an Imperial [[Battle at DS 5|attack]] on the facility in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the battle, the ships laid [[Mine/Legends|mine]]s around the station.

==Behind the scenes==
''Badger 1'' and ''Badger 2'' appeared in the [[1994]] video game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']].<ref name="TieHard">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref> The ferries can be optionally destroyed by the player during the mission "Tactical Superiority"; doing so will net the player 3,000 points for each ship.<ref name="TieHarder">''[[TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
